brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu included New York State Assemblymember Zohran Mamdani on a campaign billboard listing "enemies," alongside Iran and Hezbollah, according to Mondoweiss. Mamdani, a Palestinian-American, has been vocal in his criticism of Israeli policies. The billboard represents a shift in Netanyahu's messaging as he faces domestic political pressure.

The inclusion signals Netanyahu's concern about losing support among American constituencies critical of his government's actions, the outlet reported. Netanyahu's move suggests he views domestic American opposition as a threat comparable to external adversaries, marking an escalation in his rhetoric against critics abroad.
dek: Netanyahu's campaign billboard lumps Zohran Mamdani with Iran and Hezbollah as an "enemy", an admission that he's losing America, and that no successor will fix Israel's underlying apartheid problem.
title: Netanyahu names Palestinian-American legislator as political enemy.
